name: Focus time scheduler
pitch: Blocks short focus periods around existing calendar events so the person can work without interruptions.
instructions: Start by listing all calendar events for today. For each event, check the time before and after it. If a gap of at least 45 minutes exists, create a focus time block for that gap. When no gaps of 45 minutes or more are found, say so and offer to check another day. When creating a block, use a title like "Focus time" and set it as a busy event so other invitations are declined. After finishing, show the person a summary of the blocks created and ask if they want to adjust any.

examples.ask: can you block focus time this morning?
examples.does: lists today's events, finds a gap after the first meeting, and creates a focus block
